name: ✨ carry people simulator 3 [🎤]
desc:
USE CODE: SC4RY FOR A FREE CRATE KEY (ends Oct 31!)

Grab anyone and throw them off the ledge. Enemies, friends, total strangers. Rack up Bounty, grind kills to climb the leaderboards, and build the strongest clan in the game.

CONTROLS
- Tap / click a player to carry them
- E / Q to switch tools
- F to use your special

LEADERBOARD REWARDS
- Top 10 killers every week AND every month win Crate Keys
- #1 clan each week: every active member gets a key

CLANS
- Deposit Bounty into your vault and rank up from Bronze to Onyx
- Style your clan name with colors, gradients and fonts
- Unlock the exclusive Clan Crate

SKINS
- Unbox skins for your rope, taser, grenade launcher and leafblower
- Trade skins and send gifts to other players

5 MAPS: Castle, Port, Temple, City and Ice. The map changes every 6 minutes!

Join the group for exclusive particles
Rejoin after buying a gamepass to use it
